say:0:1211301001:0.text: There are a lot of shallows around here, and look at those massive beast bones...
say:0:1211301001:0.source_cn: 这附近散落着许多浅滩，还有好巨大的兽骨……
say:0:1211301001:0.male: There are a lot of shallows around here, and look at those massive beast bones...
say:0:1211301001:0.female: There are a lot of shallows around here, and look at those massive beast bones...

say:1:1211301002:0.text: Hold the helm tight, steer clear of the reefs.
say:1:1211301002:0.male: Hold the helm tight, steer clear of the reefs.
say:1:1211301002:0.female: Hold the helm tight, steer clear of the reefs.

say:0:1211302001:0.text: We're here at last. This is where the Dead Tide Fleet's ship is anchored.
say:0:1211302001:0.source_cn: 总算让我找到了，这里泊着死潮舰队的船。
say:0:1211302001:0.male: We're here at last. This is where the Dead Tide Fleet's ship is anchored.
say:0:1211302001:0.female: We're here at last. This is where the Dead Tide Fleet's ship is anchored.

say:1:1211302002:0.text: I'm coming for you, Dead Tide scum!
say:1:1211302002:0.male: I'm coming for you, Dead Tide scum!
say:1:1211302002:0.female: I'm coming for you, Dead Tide scum!

say:1:1211304002:0.text: There seems to be something in that cage!
say:1:1211304002:0.source_cn: 咦，旁边的营地笼子里好像有什么东西？
say:1:1211304002:0.male: There seems to be something in that cage!
say:1:1211304002:0.female: There seems to be something in that cage!

say:3:1211305002:1.text: What kind of animal is that...?

say:5:1211305003:1.text: Seems like it's trying to communicate with us.
say:5:1211305003:1.source_cn: 感觉它在试图向我们传达什么……

choice_prompt:6:1211305003.text: Seems like it's trying to communicate with us.
choice_prompt:6:1211305003.source_cn: 感觉它在试图向我们传达什么……

say:10:1211305005:1.text: It was probably captured by the Dead Tide Fleet for experiments. Poor thing.
say:10:1211305005:1.source_cn: 被死潮舰队抓来做实验的生物么。

say:11:1211305006:1.text: Shoo, little one. Return to where you came from.
say:11:1211305006:1.source_cn: 走吧，从哪里来，回哪里去。

choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 别看我，我不会动物交谈

choice:6:2:3.text: What's that on its head? A hat?
choice:6:2:3.male: What's that on its head? A hat?
choice:6:2:3.female: What's that on its head? A hat?

say:0:1211307001:0.text: It's not heading toward the sea. It's actually going forward.
say:0:1211307001:0.source_cn: 咦，它没逃走，反而往前跑了。

say:1:1211307002:0.text: As long as it doesn't catch the enemy's attention, just let it be.
say:1:1211307002:0.source_cn: 只要不暴露我们，由它去。

say:0:1211308001:0.text: Huh. It's actually lighting torches as it goes.
say:0:1211308001:0.source_cn: 真讽刺，他们竟然沿路点了火把。
say:0:1211308001:0.male: Huh. It's actually lighting torches as it goes.
say:0:1211308001:0.female: Huh. It's actually lighting torches as it goes.

say:1:1211308002:0.text: To live is to seek light and to cling to hope.
say:1:1211308002:0.source_cn: 活人才需要光明与希望。
say:1:1211308002:0.male: To live is to seek light and to cling to hope.
say:1:1211308002:0.female: To live is to seek light and to cling to hope.

say:0:1211309001:0.text: This gate is also shut tight!

say:1:1211309002:0.text: Keep looking, there must be another way in.
say:1:1211309002:0.source_cn: 继续找。肯定有进入的方法。

say:0:1211311001:0.text: Hey, it's the little fish monster we rescued earlier!
say:0:1211311001:0.source_cn: 看前面，是我们之前救出的小鱼怪！

say:1:1211311002:0.text: It seems its friend was also captured.
say:1:1211311002:0.source_cn: 原来它的同伴也被死潮抓住了。

say:2:1211312003:0.text: Looks like it's guiding us somewhere.
say:2:1211312003:0.male: Looks like it's guiding us somewhere.
say:2:1211312003:0.female: Looks like it's guiding us somewhere.

say:3:1211313002:1.text: That fish monster is gone... Did it return to the sea?
say:3:1211313002:1.source_cn: 那个小鱼怪不见了……它渡海了吗？

say:6:1211313004:1.text: The heavily guarded camp of the Dead Tide Fleet is just up that hillside. We've circled around and reached the other side.
say:6:1211313004:1.source_cn: 从方位来看，死潮舰队严防死守的重要营地就在旁边的山坡上...
say:6:1211313004:1.male: The heavily guarded camp of the Dead Tide Fleet is just up that hillside. We've circled around and reached the other side.
say:6:1211313004:1.female: The heavily guarded camp of the Dead Tide Fleet is just up that hillside. We've circled around and reached the other side.

say:7:1211313005:1.text: I'm not sure if that creature did it on purpose, but it was a huge help for us. Now we can attack their weakly defended rear.
say:7:1211313005:1.source_cn: 不知道那只生物有心还是无意。但对我们来说，正好。可以从...
say:7:1211313005:1.male: I'm not sure if that creature did it on purpose, but it was a huge help for us. Now we can attack their weakly defended rear.
say:7:1211313005:1.female: I'm not sure if that creature did it on purpose, but it was a huge help for us. Now we can attack their weakly defended rear.

choice_prompt:9:1211313005.text: I'm not sure if that creature did it on purpose, but it was a huge help for us. Now we can attack their weakly defended rear.
choice_prompt:9:1211313005.source_cn: 不知道那只生物有心还是无意。但对我们来说，正好。可以从防守薄弱的后方突袭。
choice_prompt:9:1211313005.male: I'm not sure if that creature did it on purpose, but it was a huge help for us. Now we can attack their weakly defended rear.
choice_prompt:9:1211313005.female: I'm not sure if that creature did it on purpose, but it was a huge help for us. Now we can attack their weakly defended rear.

say:10:1211313006:1.text: Get ready, everyone. Let's proceed with caution.
say:10:1211313006:1.male: Get ready, everyone. Let's proceed with caution.
say:10:1211313006:1.female: Get ready, everyone. Let's proceed with caution.

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 越到这时，越要提高警惕

choice:9:1:2.text: Doing good deeds does pay off!
choice:9:1:2.male: Doing good deeds does pay off!
choice:9:1:2.female: Doing good deeds does pay off!

say:0:1211317001:0.text: Careful, don't let their men spot us!
say:0:1211317001:0.source_cn: 小心，别被他们的人发现！
say:0:1211317001:0.male: Careful, don't let their men spot us!
say:0:1211317001:0.female: Careful, don't let their men spot us!

say:0:1211318001:0.text: Good job. We successfully got through the guarded area.
say:0:1211318001:0.source_cn: 干得好。成功通过警戒区了。
say:0:1211318001:0.male: Good job. We successfully got through the guarded area.
say:0:1211318001:0.female: Good job. We successfully got through the guarded area.

say:1:1211318002:0.text: I wouldn't have expected you to be so good at stealth just by looking at you.
say:1:1211318002:0.source_cn: 看不出来，你也有潜伏刺杀的天赋。
say:1:1211318002:0.male: I wouldn't have expected you to be so good at stealth just by looking at you.
say:1:1211318002:0.female: I wouldn't have expected you to be so good at stealth just by looking at you.

say:1:1211319001:1.text: So, the little rats hiding in the shadows have finally showed themselves.
say:1:1211319001:1.source_cn: 躲在阴影里的老鼠。终于现身了。
say:1:1211319001:1.male: So, the little rats hiding in the shadows have finally showed themselves.
say:1:1211319001:1.female: So, the little rats hiding in the shadows have finally showed themselves.

say:3:1211319002:1.text: That chat back at the camp was just a ploy to lure us here?
say:3:1211319002:1.source_cn: ……原来如此。刚才在营地里那番话是故意讲给我们听的，为...

say:4:1211319003:1.text: I figured your brains had decayed long ago in the seawater.
say:4:1211319003:1.source_cn: 我还以为死潮舰队的脑子早就在海水里泡烂了。

say:7:1211319004:0.text: Dear Bonnie, do you not see the perfect opportunity to test our latest technology?
say:7:1211319004:0.source_cn: 亲爱的波妮，不觉得这是个试用新技术的好时机吗？

say:10:1211319005:1.text: You don't need to jump in. I can handle this alone.
say:10:1211319005:1.source_cn: 不用你动手，我自己就可以对付他们。

say:11:1211319006:1.text: Such a waste, with these fresh bodies at our disposal...
say:11:1211319006:1.source_cn: 可惜，这么多鲜活的肉体……
say:11:1211319006:1.male: Such a waste, with these fresh bodies at our disposal...
say:11:1211319006:1.female: Such a waste, with these fresh bodies at our disposal...

choice_prompt:12:1211319006.text: Such a waste, with these fresh bodies at our disposal...
choice_prompt:12:1211319006.source_cn: 可惜，这么多鲜活的肉体……
choice_prompt:12:1211319006.male: Such a waste, with these fresh bodies at our disposal...
choice_prompt:12:1211319006.female: Such a waste, with these fresh bodies at our disposal...

say:15:1211319007:1.text: Not launching a surprise attack on us earlier was your biggest blunder!
say:15:1211319007:1.source_cn: 没在刚才发动突袭，将是你们做出的最错误的决定！
say:15:1211319007:1.male: Not launching a surprise attack on us earlier was your biggest blunder!
say:15:1211319007:1.female: Not launching a surprise attack on us earlier was your biggest blunder!

choice:12:0:1.text: You think you can take us on alone?
choice:12:0:1.male: You think you can take us on alone?
choice:12:0:1.female: You think you can take us on alone?

choice:12:2:3.text: This will end badly for you.
choice:12:2:3.male: This will end badly for you.
choice:12:2:3.female: This will end badly for you.

say:1:1211322002:0.text: After them! This is our best chance to end this.
say:1:1211322002:0.source_cn: 追，这是解决他们的最好时机。
say:1:1211322002:0.male: After them! This is our best chance to end this.
say:1:1211322002:0.female: After them! This is our best chance to end this.

say:0:1211324001:0.source_cn: 那个亡灵术士，他想做什么？

say:1:1211324002:0.text: I've got a bad feeling about this. Let's hurry and catch up to them.
say:1:1211324002:0.source_cn: 我有不好的预感，快追上他们。
say:1:1211324002:0.male: I've got a bad feeling about this. Let's hurry and catch up to them.
say:1:1211324002:0.female: I've got a bad feeling about this. Let's hurry and catch up to them.

narration:0:1211401101:0.source_cn: 我们航行到了不死号附近……

say:4:1211303001:1.text: Look! The door on the hillside is sealed shut!
say:4:1211303001:1.source_cn: ——你们看，山坡上那道门被封住了！
say:4:1211303001:1.male: Look! The door on the hillside is sealed shut!
say:4:1211303001:1.female: Look! The door on the hillside is sealed shut!

say:6:1211303002:1.text: There are lots of guards patrolling around it.
say:6:1211303002:1.source_cn: 周围还有人在把守巡逻呢。

say:9:1211303003:1.text: With that tight of a defense, it proves we're in the right place.
say:9:1211303003:1.source_cn: 防卫得越严密，越说明来对了地方。

say:10:1211303004:1.text: We should avoid the main entrance and find another way in.
say:10:1211303004:1.source_cn: 先绕过正门，避开耳目。我们换条路走。
say:10:1211303004:1.male: We should avoid the main entrance and find another way in.
say:10:1211303004:1.female: We should avoid the main entrance and find another way in.

narration:13:12011313:0.text: Finally, you find the Dead Tide Fleet's base onshore. However, the gate is tightly shut, and the area is heavily guarded.
narration:13:12011313:0.source_cn: 你们终于找到了死潮舰队在陆上的所在地。但这里大门紧闭，...

say:4:1211314001:0.text: Wait! Stay still and keep your voices down.

say:7:1211314003:0.text: Shh, there's noise coming from the camp ahead.
say:7:1211314003:0.source_cn: 嘘，前面的营地里有声音。
say:7:1211314003:0.male: Shh, there's noise coming from the camp ahead.
say:7:1211314003:0.female: Shh, there's noise coming from the camp ahead.

say:12:1211315001:0.text: How can you be calmly doing research at a time like this?!
say:12:1211315001:0.source_cn: 情况紧急，你还在这里慢条斯理地搞什么研究？！

say:14:1211315002:0.text: And why not, my dear Bonnie?
say:14:1211315002:0.source_cn: 亲爱的波妮，为什么不呢？

say:15:1211315003:0.text: Wars inevitably conclude in peace, their outcomes predictable. But the pursuit of the unknown? Ah, that is where true excitement lies...
say:15:1211315003:0.source_cn: 战争最后总是会以或短或长的和平结束，结果已经在预期中。...

say:17:1211315005:1.text: Listen up! The Chainkeeper is maneuvering with the main fleet to the east. Once we deploy the small boats, they'll fire warning shots, and the main ship will steer away at full sail.
say:17:1211315005:1.source_cn: 听好。现在枷锁号正和主舰队在东边的海面周旋，我们一放下...

say:18:1211315006:0.text: Those rats from Rustport have definitely changed captains. This isn't their usual style.
say:18:1211315006:0.source_cn: 那群锈锚港的老鼠换了指挥，绝对没错，这不是他们以往的风格。

say:19:1211315007:0.text: So, those incessantly panting monkeys have finally attained some measure of wisdom. A fascinating revelation indeed.
say:19:1211315007:0.source_cn: 啊，所以那些喘个不停的猿猴启智了，这是个有趣的新发现。

say:20:1211315008:1.text: Why, pray tell, should I halt my critical experiments for such petty concerns?
say:20:1211315008:1.source_cn: 何必要为这种琐事中断我重要的实验呢？

say:21:1211315009:1.text: Uhh, you don't understand. A big battle is coming, and their captain has changed. So that brings up the question, where did their previous captain go?
say:21:1211315009:1.source_cn: 哼，大战在即，领头的却换人了。那他们之前的头儿去了哪里？

say:22:1211315010:1.text: One might assume... they are concocting some special scheme against our dear captain?
say:22:1211315010:1.source_cn: 常理来说……比如，在筹备对船长的特别计划？

say:23:1211315011:1.text: You finally understand! So stop obsessing over your little experiments. If we lose this battle, you'll end up with nothing.
say:23:1211315011:1.source_cn: 知道就好！别整天盯着实验和进展了，要是吃了败仗，你什么...

say:24:1211315012:1.text: Come with me. This isn't a suggestion; it's an order. I've thought of a way to hit that fly buzzing around the sea, but I'll need your help.
say:24:1211315012:1.source_cn: 这不是询问，是命令。跟我来，我有办法击中那只在海上乱飞...

say:25:1211315013:0.text: Quickly now, before that filthy ship ruins our captain's mood. We'll drag those escaped rats out from their corners, inch by inch...
say:25:1211315013:0.source_cn: 速战速决，别让那艘破船搅坏船长的好心情。然后我们再一寸...

say:30:1211316001:0.text: Did you hear that? That Graveborn lady said Sinbad's maneuvering with their fleet!
say:30:1211316001:0.source_cn: 你们听见了吗，那个亡灵女人说辛巴达正在和他们的舰队周旋！

say:32:1211316002:0.text: Bonnie... You don't know her well, but this is a chance I can't pass up. I've faced her in battle many times.
say:32:1211316002:0.source_cn: 波妮……你们还不了解她。我们交过很多次手。

say:33:1211316003:0.text: Besides commanding in battles, she's also a formidable archer. From my previous clashes with her, she's able to precisely target navigators or the helmsman. She's a tough opponent.
say:33:1211316003:0.source_cn: 除了指挥作战，她用弓也很强。几次海上相逢，我们的船能靠...

say:34:1211316004:0.text: It takes just a single second of chaos before the Graveborn set up grappling hooks and rope ladders, turning sea battles into hand-to-hand combat. Many of my crew have fallen at her hands...
say:34:1211316004:0.source_cn: 只需要片刻慌乱，那群亡灵就能搭起钩索和绳梯，然后就是刀...

say:35:1211316005:0.text: If we can take her down here, it will be a major blow to Hodgkin!
say:35:1211316005:0.source_cn: 如果能在这里干掉她，就能断掉霍德希金一条手臂……！

say:37:1211316006:0.text: Calm down, Sonja! You look like you're about to start breathing fire like a dragon!

say:38:1211316007:0.text: We came here to gather intel on the Dead Tide Fleet. If we act recklessly, we'll be exposed!
say:38:1211316007:0.source_cn: 我们来这里是为了摸清死潮舰队的底细。要是贸然出击，就完...

say:39:1211316008:0.text: I know. But I will get my way someday... There has been too much blood spilled. My fallen Whispers must be avenged.
say:39:1211316008:0.source_cn: 我知道。但我不会忍耐很久……血薇帮流出过的鲜血，必须要...

say:40:1211316009:0.text: Psst. Someone distract her... By the way, why don't we try using the magic communicator Hugin gave us? We can let Sinbad know what we overheard.
say:40:1211316009:0.source_cn: 对了，趁现在，要试试呼金给的魔法通讯器吗？可以把我们听...

say:41:1211316010:0.text: We should warn them to prepare for those two, they seem very menacing.
say:41:1211316010:0.source_cn: 他和呼金不一定是刚才那两个人的对手……

choice_prompt:42:1211316010.text: We should warn them to prepare for those two, they seem very menacing.
choice_prompt:42:1211316010.source_cn: 他和呼金不一定是刚才那两个人的对手……

say:44:1211316012:0.text: Ahem. Sinbad, are you there? Can you hear me?
say:44:1211316012:0.source_cn: 咳……嗯，辛巴达，在吗？能听到吗？

say:46:1211316014:0.text: Oh oh, Chippy wants to try too! Sinbad, it's us!
say:46:1211316014:0.source_cn: 咦，真的有声音！辛巴达，是我们！

say:50:1211316017:0.text: ... It got cut off. Hugin's gadgets usually work great, but this one is still being tested.
say:50:1211316017:0.source_cn: ……中断了。呼金做的东西，果然不多试验几次就不行。
say:50:1211316017:0.male: ... It got cut off. Hugin's gadgets usually work great, but this one is still being tested.
say:50:1211316017:0.female: ... It got cut off. Hugin's gadgets usually work great, but this one is still being tested.

say:51:1211316018:0.text: It's alright, let's put our faith in Sinbad. I doubt anything bad will happen to him, he's got the luck of a cat with nine lives.
say:51:1211316018:0.source_cn: 先收好，相信辛巴达那小子的技术和运气吧。
say:51:1211316018:0.male: It's alright, let's put our faith in Sinbad. I doubt anything bad will happen to him, he's got the luck of a cat with nine lives.
say:51:1211316018:0.female: It's alright, let's put our faith in Sinbad. I doubt anything bad will happen to him, he's got the luck of a cat with nine lives.

say:52:1211316019:0.text: We need to find a way <style="highlight">through the patrol area</style> and catch up with those two Graveborn. Let's see if we can overhear some more crucial information.
say:52:1211316019:0.source_cn: 咱们得想办法<style=highlight>通过前面...
say:52:1211316019:0.male: We need to find a way <style="highlight">through the patrol area</style> and catch up with those two Graveborn. Let's see if we can overhear some more crucial information.
say:52:1211316019:0.female: We need to find a way <style="highlight">through the patrol area</style> and catch up with those two Graveborn. Let's see if we can overhear some more crucial information.

narration:57:12011322:0.text: You stop in your tracks when you notice Viperian and Bonnie engaged in conversation ahead.
narration:57:12011322:0.source_cn: 你们停下脚步，注意到了前方正在交谈的维珀里安和波妮。

choice:42:0:1.text: Let's hope he's not too busy.
choice:42:0:1.male: Let's hope he's not too busy.
choice:42:0:1.female: Let's hope he's not too busy.

choice:42:1:2.source_cn: 他能灵活兼顾海战和联络？

choice:42:2:3.text: I want to try out new tech!
choice:42:2:3.male: I want to try out new tech!
choice:42:2:3.female: I want to try out new tech!

narration:58:12011322:0.text: You stop in your tracks when you notice Viperian and Bonnie engaged in conversation ahead.
narration:58:12011322:0.source_cn: 你们停下脚步，注意到了前方正在交谈的维珀里安和波妮。

narration:59:12011322:0.text: You stop in your tracks when you notice Viperian and Bonnie engaged in conversation ahead.
narration:59:12011322:0.source_cn: 你们停下脚步，注意到了前方正在交谈的维珀里安和波妮。

narration:60:12011322:0.text: You stop in your tracks when you notice Viperian and Bonnie engaged in conversation ahead.
narration:60:12011322:0.source_cn: 你们停下脚步，注意到了前方正在交谈的维珀里安和波妮。

cinematic_dialogue:2:1211325001:.text: To achieve immortality, you must offer up flesh and blood.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1211325001:.male: To achieve immortality, you must offer up flesh and blood.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1211325001:.female: To achieve immortality, you must offer up flesh and blood.

say:4:1211326001:0.text: What kind of monster is that?!
say:4:1211326001:0.male: What kind of monster is that?!
say:4:1211326001:0.female: What kind of monster is that?!

say:6:1211326002:0.text: I, the esteemed chief researcher of the Dead Tide Fleet, offer you all a gift.
say:6:1211326002:0.source_cn: 死潮舰队首席研究员维珀里安，呈敬给各位的礼物。
say:6:1211326002:0.male: I, the esteemed chief researcher of the Dead Tide Fleet, offer you all a gift.
say:6:1211326002:0.female: I, the esteemed chief researcher of the Dead Tide Fleet, offer you all a gift.

say:9:1211326003:0.text: That thing he's holding... It's the same one Hodgkin used to control Nara!
say:9:1211326003:0.source_cn: 他手里那东西……之前在海上相遇时，霍德希金就是用那东西...

say:10:1211326004:0.text: Allow me to correct you. Nara is ours. Every fiber of her being, from soul to patchwork body, belongs to the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:10:1211326004:0.source_cn: 我要纠正一点，奈拉是我们的人，从灵魂到那具拼凑而成的身...

say:11:1211326005:0.text: This little one beside me now is a mere defective specimen.
say:11:1211326005:0.source_cn: 现在身边这个小家伙，只是个残次品。

say:12:1211326006:0.text: It's regrettable. Even with the sacred artifact's power, creations like Nara and Bonnie defy mass production...
say:12:1211326006:0.source_cn: 实在可惜，像奈拉和波妮这么优秀的造物，即便凭借圣器的力...

say:14:1211326008:0.text: I don't expect you to grasp the greatness of immortality. Suppress your base instincts and see reason, stop randomly howling like a wild monkey.
say:14:1211326008:0.source_cn: 我不奢求你们理解不朽的伟大之处。但至少学会压抑生物本能...
say:14:1211326008:0.male: I don't expect you to grasp the greatness of immortality. Suppress your base instincts and see reason, stop randomly howling like a wild monkey.
say:14:1211326008:0.female: I don't expect you to grasp the greatness of immortality. Suppress your base instincts and see reason, stop randomly howling like a wild monkey.

say:15:1211326009:1.text: I have very high expectations for you all. I'm short on experimental resources, and these marine creatures offer limited research potential.
say:15:1211326009:1.source_cn: 我对你们有很高的期待。实验材料严重紧缺，这些海洋生物虽...
say:15:1211326009:1.male: I have very high expectations for you all. I'm short on experimental resources, and these marine creatures offer limited research potential.
say:15:1211326009:1.female: I have very high expectations for you all. I'm short on experimental resources, and these marine creatures offer limited research potential.

say:16:1211326010:1.text: With you all here, we'll have secured valuable human bodies and two rodents. I'm quite giddy to think about what kind of tests I'll run on you all.
say:16:1211326010:1.source_cn: 感谢你们，又能取得宝贵的人类躯体了。还附赠两只啮齿动物...
say:16:1211326010:1.male: With you all here, we'll have secured valuable human bodies and two rodents. I'm quite giddy to think about what kind of tests I'll run on you all.
say:16:1211326010:1.female: With you all here, we'll have secured valuable human bodies and two rodents. I'm quite giddy to think about what kind of tests I'll run on you all.

choice_prompt:17:1211326010.text: With you all here, we'll have secured valuable human bodies and two rodents. I'm quite giddy to think about what kind of tests I'll run on you all.
choice_prompt:17:1211326010.source_cn: 感谢你们，又能取得宝贵的人类躯体了。还附赠两只啮齿动物。要拿他们怎么办好呢……

choice_prompt:17:1211326010.female: With you all here, we'll have secured valuable human bodies and two rodents. I'm quite giddy to think about what kind of tests I'll run on you all.

say:19:1211326012:0.text: Handle them gently, little one. That mage's body is invaluable for our studies.
say:19:1211326012:0.source_cn: 小家伙，别撕得太碎。那个魔法师的躯体很有研究价值……
say:19:1211326012:0.male: Handle them gently, little one. That mage's body is invaluable for our studies.
say:19:1211326012:0.female: Handle them gently, little one. That mage's body is invaluable for our studies.

say:22:1211326013:0.source_cn: 主人，小心！那怪物要攻过来了！

choice:17:0:1.text: You think you can beat us?!
choice:17:0:1.source_cn: 那要看你有没有这个本事！
choice:17:0:1.male: You think you can beat us?!
choice:17:0:1.female: You think you can beat us?!

choice:17:1:2.text: Even with your magic, you'll lose.
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 有趣的魔法，但拦不住我们
choice:17:1:2.male: Even with your magic, you'll lose.
choice:17:1:2.female: Even with your magic, you'll lose.

narration:25:12011326:0.text: After a long chase, you manage to catch up with Bonnie and Viperian. You see Viperian transform a small sea monster into a massive beast.
narration:25:12011326:0.source_cn: 好不容易追上波妮和维珀里安，维珀里安却用亡灵法术将一个...

say:6:1211329002:0.text: This is why I hate people who use magic.

say:9:1211329004:0.text: Let's set sail, towards the Immortal.
say:9:1211329004:0.source_cn: 出航吧，向着不死号航行。
say:9:1211329004:0.male: Let's set sail, towards the Immortal.
say:9:1211329004:0.female: Let's set sail, towards the Immortal.

say:11:1211329005:1.text: This time, we'll definitely crush the Dead Tide Fleet and disperse the fog around Rustport!
say:11:1211329005:1.source_cn: 这次一定要击溃死潮舰队，驱散锈锚港的迷雾！
say:11:1211329005:1.male: This time, we'll definitely crush the Dead Tide Fleet and disperse the fog around Rustport!
say:11:1211329005:1.female: This time, we'll definitely crush the Dead Tide Fleet and disperse the fog around Rustport!

choice:8:1:2.text: He said he'd meet us on the ship.
choice:8:1:2.male: He said he'd meet us on the ship.
choice:8:1:2.female: He said he'd meet us on the ship.

choice:8:2:3.text: I'm ready for the final battle.
choice:8:2:3.male: I'm ready for the final battle.
choice:8:2:3.female: I'm ready for the final battle.

narration:14:12011328:0.text: Viperian abruptly stops attacking you and opens the escape portal instead.
narration:14:12011328:0.source_cn: 维珀里安突然放弃了对你们的攻击，转而打开了逃跑的传送门。

cinematic_dialogue:1:1211323002:.text: Viperian, what are you up to...?

cinematic_dialogue:1:1211323003:.text: Shh, do not disturb my little darlings.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1211323003:.source_cn: 嘘，别吵到我的小宝贝们……

subtitle:1:1211091002:.text: She couldn't have vanished into thin air.
